newsitem.title: USA: National-Oilwell merging with Dreco Energy.
newsitem.headline: National-Oilwell merging with Dreco Energy.

text.p: National-Oilwell Inc on Wednesday said it has signed a definitive agreement to merge with Dreco Energy Services Ltd, in a deal calling for an exchange of shares.

Each Dreco share would be exchanged for 1.2 shares of National-Oilwell stock, if during the 20 consecutive trading days ending five days before closing, National-Oilwell's average stock price were between $36.00 and $47.25.

If the average stock price were above $47.25, the exchange ratio would adjust to provide Dreco holders with $56.70 of National-Oilwell common stock, and, if the average stock price were below $36.00, the exchange ratio would adjust to provide Dreco holders with $43.20 of National-Oilwell common stock.
National-Oilwell said it would issue about 9.4 million shares of its common stock valued at $366 million, based on a 1.2 exchange ratio.

The combination is expected to be accretive to estimated 1997 earnings per share of National-Oilwell -- excluding one-time charges related to expenses associated with the transaction, National-Oilwell said.

The merger has been approved by the boards of directors of both companies. Holders of about 52 percent of National-Oilwell's common stock, as well as the chairman and president of Dreco, have entered into voting agreements in support of the transaction.
It is anticipated that shareholders' meetings and the closing of the transaction would occur during the third quarter of 1997, the company said.
